features.text: Non-removable clasp ensures the walker boot is worn correctly.
Specifically designed for the Ossur Rebound Diabetic Walker.
Easy to replace and adjust for a comfortable and secure fit.
Promotes patient compliance and proper healing.
Pack of 5 straps provides convenient replacements.

measurement: These straps are designed to fit the Ossur Rebound Diabetic Walker. Refer to our sizing chart to ensure you have the correct size walker boot. For personalized assistance, visit our Perfect Fit Promise page and receive expert fitting advice from our medical team.
